\section{\texttt{write\_feedback\_csv}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.synthetic_data.write_feedback_csv}\index{Functions!write\_feedback\_csv}

Generate synthetic feedback and write it to a CSV file.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
write_feedback_csv(config: SyntheticDataConfig, output: str | Path) -> Path
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{config}] \texttt{SyntheticDataConfig}, required. Generation parameters.
  \item[\texttt{output}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required. Destination CSV path.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{Path}. The path the CSV was written to.
\apifield{Details}Parent directories are created as needed. The file is written with UTF-8 encoding and \texttt{\textbackslash{}n} newlines, so the same seed and parameters produce a byte-identical file on any platform.
